calibration.answer_search: Found PQ-readiness SCANNERS but they target remote endpoints: Anvil Secure 'PQCscan' (ssh-scan/tls-scan), qubitac AC-Scanner (TLS+SSH, CBOM), QRAMM tls-analyzer (Go, TLS grade), 'mini PQC scanner', PostQ (SaaS+).
